player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ {max_rounds} round agoro a ɛyɛ Kuhn Poker.
Agoro Mmara:
- Kuhn Poker de 3-card deck a ɛwɔ J, Q, K (J yɛ nea ɛwɔ ase, K yɛ nea ɛwɔ soro sen)
- Ɔmanfoɔ biara antes {ante} chip na wɔnya 1 card biara round (hwɛ na cards no wɔdeɛ wɔnnyɛ replacement, enti wo nnya card koro no ara ne wo opponent).
- Agoro no kɔ so {max_rounds} rounds
- Ɔmanfoɔ a ɔwɔ sika dodoɔ akyi rounds nyinaa na ɔdi nkunim
Action Mmara:
- '[check]': Fa mu wɔ betting (efi sɛ betting biara nni table no so)
- '[bet]': Ka 1 chip kɔ pot no mu (efi sɛ betting biara nni table no so)
- '[call]': Yɛ ne opponent betting no ara kwa ka 1 chip kɔ pot no mu
- '[fold]': Gyae wo hand na ma wo opponent noa pot no

showdown.showdown_summary: Nkratafa no: Odwumfo {winner} {winner_card} di Odwumfo {loser} {loser_card} so. Odwumfo {winner} di nkɔmmɔ no a ɛyɛ {pot_value} nkrataa.

outcome.draw: Wɔ {max_rounds} mfinimfini no, na agyinatufo baanu nyinaa wɔ chips dodow koro.
outcome.winner_player0: Ɔdi agorufo 0 no dii nkonim denam sɛ ɔwɔ chips pii wɔ {max_rounds} mfinimfini nyinaa.
outcome.winner_player1: Ɔbɔadeɛ 1 dii nkonim denam sɛ ɔwɔ chips bebree wɔ {max_rounds} mfinimfini nyinaa.
